description:
Extend the UI git-tree renderer (bl-209e) from v0.1-shape (flat linear
commits on main) to v0.2-shape (ex/<ts>-<id> branches with --no-ff merge
commits back to main, per ARCH §2.6).

=== Context ===
v0.2 functional body landed on main (bl-effb, bl-e7e1, bl-a764, bl-8c66);
v0.2-shape repos exist now. The v0.5 epic description explicitly plans
this extension: "Git tree renderer against v0.1-shape repos ... Extends
naturally when v0.2 adds branches."

=== What to build ===
- Renderer reads the current git state (main + any ex/ branches) and
  produces a view model distinguishing:
    - merged exchanges: main's merge commits with their second parent
      pointing at an ex/ branch (now collapsed post-merge)
    - in-flight exchanges: ex/ branches still pointing somewhere off main
    - step commits inside an exchange (linear commits on the ex/ branch
      before the merge)
- View model stays a pure function of filesystem state (statelessness
  per v0.5 epic alignment gate).
- branches.json read to surface unmerged-count and in-flight branch
  set (its shape is already stable per bl-a764).

=== Explicit non-goals ===
- Streaming text indicators (future v0.5 subtask).
- Pulsing tool indicators (v0.3 + future v0.5 subtask).
- Branch-state indicators for stopped/conflicted (future v0.5 subtask;
  v0.2 only produces in-flight + merged).

=== Testing ===
- Unit tests over hand-built v0.2-shape fixtures (real tiny repos on a
  tmpdir, not mocks — matches bl-209e's pattern).
- Cover: single merged exchange, single in-flight exchange, multi-step
  in-flight exchange, mixed main-only history (v0.1-shape still renders).
- cargo test + tarpaulin --fail-under 100 green.

=== Done-when ===
Renderer handles v0.2-shape repos end-to-end; existing v0.1-shape tests
still green (backwards-compatible extension). Module docs updated.
title: UI: git-tree renderer for v0.2-shape repos
